## What's Changed

- Add OAuth 2.0 client-credentials authentication for Loki and reuse HTTP clients across Loki and Prometheus.
- Fix ClickHouse AI filter escaping and stop offering unsupported Elasticsearch substring filters.

## Known limitations

- In a local smoke test, Qwen 2.5 7B misread sampled 503/504 records as no 5xx errors and could not map a grouped-count request. Verify AI results; fixes are still needed.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/InvestiGenie/investigenie/compare/0.6.6...0.6.7-rc
